headline: Argentine Country Risk Rises as Domestic Equities and Bonds Fall
summary: Argentina's country risk index rose to 763 points as the MSCI Merval dropped 1.2% and sovereign bonds fell 1.3% on average, driven by weakness in Brazilian markets.
why: Argentine financial assets remain vulnerable to regional emerging market sentiment and foreign currency constraints.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Rising country risk raises financing costs for both sovereign and corporate borrowers.

why_moved: Spillover weakness from Brazilian asset selloffs prompted broad declines across Argentine stocks and debt.
